recruiter_103.content: tell me about projects of jaydeep

Below is a concise overview of the three projects listed on Jaydeep Nitin Gedam’s profile. For each project I’ve highlighted its purpose, the key technologies used, the main features that were built, and Jaydeep’s specific responsibilities. --- ## 1. **EpisodicAI – Cognitive Memory Infrastructure Platform** | **What it is / Goal** | A backend‑focused platform that provides a “cognitive memory” layer for AI agents. It enables agents to store, retrieve, and reason over past conversational interactions in a way that mimics human‑like memory. | |-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Core Technologies** | • FastAPI (Python web framework)
• PostgreSQL
• pgvector (PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search) | | **Key Features** | • **4‑factor ranked retrieval matrix** – retrieval scores combine semantic similarity, importance, confidence, and a recency‑decay factor.
• **Autonomous memory extraction** – automatically pulls relevant facts from dialogue streams.
• **Intelligent conflict resolution** – detects contradictory memories and creates a superseding lineage automatically.
• **Strict per‑user tenant isolation** – each user’s memory store is isolated for security and privacy. | | **Jaydeep’s Responsibilities** | • Designed the overall retrieval‑matrix architecture and the ranking algorithm.
• Implemented the autonomous extraction pipeline and the conflict‑resolution mechanism.
• Ensured multi‑tenant isolation and data‑security safeguards. | --- ## 2. **Nayaan – Smart Device for Visually Impaired and Blind People** | **What it is / Goal** | An assistive hardware‑software solution that helps visually impaired and blind users interact with their environment through OCR, offline language‑model inference, and natural‑language interfaces. | |-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Core Technologies** | • PaddleOCR Engine (optical‑character recognition)
• DFRobot offline LLM model
• Custom NLP interface
• Front‑end UI (technology stack not specified) | | **Key Features** | • Real‑time text extraction from printed material using OCR.
• Offline LLM processing for conversational assistance without needing internet connectivity.
• NLP‑driven voice interaction tailored to blind users.
• **Research & IP** – requirement analysis with >50 blind students/faculty, a filed patent (Application No 202321065172), and a research paper published in a Springer journal. | | **Jaydeep’s Responsibilities** | • Developed the OCR component (PaddleOCR) and integrated the offline LLM model.
• Built the NLP interface and the accompanying front‑end.
• Led the requirement‑gathering phase, conducting user studies with more than 50 visually impaired students and faculty members. | --- ## 3. **VibeCraft – AI Content Generator & Scheduler** | **What it is / Goal** | A full‑stack web application that helps marketers and content creators generate copy (e.g., blog posts, social‑media updates) using OpenAI’s models, then schedule and auto‑publish that content to LinkedIn. | |-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | **Core Technologies** | • Front‑end: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
• Back‑end: Node.js, Express
• Database: MongoDB
• Integration: OpenAI API (custom key management) | | **Key Features** | • AI‑driven generation of marketing copy and blog articles.
• Automated scheduling and direct publishing to LinkedIn.
• Audience‑targeting options for each post.
• Custom OpenAI API‑key management per user.
• Export of generated content in multiple formats (Markdown, PDF, plain text). | | **Jaydeep’s Responsibilities** | • Built the responsive front‑end using React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
• Developed the RESTful back‑end services with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
• Implemented the OpenAI integration, export utilities, and the scheduling/publishing workflow. | --- ### Summary - **EpisodicAI** showcases Jaydeep’s expertise in building sophisticated retrieval‑ranking systems and multi‑tenant backend services using FastAPI and vector databases. - **Nayaan** demonstrates his ability to combine computer‑vision (OCR), offline LLM inference, and user‑centered design for an assistive technology, plus experience in research, patent filing, and user testing. - **VibeCraft** reflects full‑stack development skills (React/TypeScript front‑end, Node/Express back‑end, MongoDB) and practical integration of generative AI services for content creation and social‑media automation. These projects collectively illustrate a blend of AI/ML‑focused backend engineering, front‑end UI development, and real‑world problem solving.
